Title: Task Tracking Feature V1 Implementation
Content: MemorySmith has a file-backed task domain at Data/Tasks with a site-level /tasks workbench and api/tasks endpoints for CRUD, status updates, comments, links, attachments, history, and soft/hard delete. Assignee handling is dictionary-first with Directory mode and optional Custom text mode. Linked page checks are warning-only: missing pages do not block linking and produce page_link_warning activity entries. Runtime hardening now includes malformed-task fallback loading: parse-failing files are represented as HasLoadError records instead of crashing list operations, with LoadError and SourceFilePath metadata. Mutations on malformed fallback records are blocked by EnsureTaskIsEditable, and phase-1 mutation endpoint contracts now map malformed-edit ArgumentException paths to client-safe 4xx responses instead of surfacing 500s on key routes. Task read APIs now enforce CanViewMemorySmith policy, and authorization behavior is test-covered for anonymous-disabled profiles. Task query behavior now supports hybrid lexical+semantic ranking with `MemorySmith:TaskSearch:HybridSemanticEnabled` defaulting to true and exposed in admin settings. Priority triage follows severity-first ordering: active exposure and availability risks before maintainability-only refactors.
